blocks.note: Load matters for the timing-sensitive tests. The first run on the replayed tree (rig server and workers active on the same VM, machine under it at load 50-60) had 7 gate failures and 1 unit error; two mutant runs in parallel containers showed the same signatures ('expected runtime_broker_runtime_lost but was runtime_provision_fenced', 'cancellation must reach the original active worker', JdbcRepositoryTest 'database operation failed'). On the quiet VM the replayed tree, the baseline and both mutants pass all stages. ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest failed once more with yet another test.
